derived_metrics.backpressure_delta_cycles: periodically stalled run minus the matching ideal run
derived_metrics.child_request_bytes: requested beats multiplied by the corresponding child port width; not an assertion about final HBM traffic
derived_metrics.writer_control_residual_cycles: observed cycles - writer_loop_ii_cycles; includes fill, drain, final flush, and deterministic child-protocol waits
derived_metrics.writer_loop_ii_cycles: 24 * inputs; the synthesized edge-loop throughput term
derived_metrics.writer_rtl_min_prediction_cycles: state-dependent Candidate10 ideal-child lower bound validated on all non-stalled valid cases

limitations: This oracle isolates the HLS child writer with deterministic response timing.
It observes child-to-adapter requests, not final U55C HBM AXI transactions.
Periodic stalls are deterministic protocol sensitivity tests, not an HBM model.

protocol.address_unit: port_data_words, converted to bytes by the kernel-level m_axi adapter
protocol.family_local: the Candidate10 writer trusts upstream family buckets and detects count mismatches at final validation
protocol.request_length: actual beats, not external AXI AxLEN minus one encoding
protocol.write_response: one internal B response per accepted AW request
